title: Tool-call responses get a clearer ending
summary:
Tool calls got more consistent responses, flux-2-dev got the proportions it was asked for, and three community projects joined the showcase.

Two team fixes aligned provider-specific finish_reason values with OpenAI responses, so completions containing tool calls report "tool_calls" even when a provider says "stop". The follow-up kept Gemini 3 thought_signature data intact rather than relying on strict compliance mode.

Flux-2-dev now maps requested dimensions to its supported square, portrait, or landscape sizes instead of ignoring width and height. Image-to-image requests continue to pass along their input images.

A community submission added Pollinations CLI to the showcase and corrected BotForgeX Laboratories’ listing. Catalog updates also added a Pollina-powered image and video editor and the browser-based writing app NovelCraft AI. These are listing changes, not changes to the apps’ code.
